###Bring in data for individual larvae (freq. of occurrence, length, etc.)
```{r}
individual_data <- read.csv("all_PIPA_larvae.csv")

#make sure cruise # is a factor and lengths are numeric
individual_data <- individual_data %>%
  mutate(Cruise = as.factor(Cruise)) %>%
  mutate(Total.Length..mm. = as.numeric(Total.Length..mm.))

individual_data_summary <- individual_data %>%
  group_by(Cruise, genus) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Cruise, genus)

individual_data_station_summary <- individual_data %>%
  group_by(Station, genus) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Station, genus)
```

###Plot frequency of occurrence for 1mm length bins for both genera
```{r}
#Katsuwonus percent frequency of occurrence per cruise
#png("katsuwonus_length_freq_by_cruise.png", units = "in", width = 6, height = 4, res = 1200)
ggplot(data = filter(individual_data, genus == "Katsuwonus"), aes(x = Total.Length..mm.)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = "darkslategray2", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, 
                 aes(y = after_stat(count / tapply(count, PANEL, sum)[PANEL] * 100))) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cruise, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Total Length (mm)", y = "Frequency (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
#dev.off()

#Thunnus percent frequency of occurrence per cruise
#png("thunnus_length_freq_by_cruise.png", units = "in", width = 6, height = 4, res = 1200)
ggplot(data = filter(individual_data, genus == "Thunnus"), aes(x = Total.Length..mm.)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = "goldenrod1", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3,
                 aes(y = after_stat(count / tapply(count, PANEL, sum)[PANEL] * 100))) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cruise, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Total Length (mm)", y = "Frequency (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
#dev.off()


#Combine
freq_data <- individual_data %>%
  filter(genus %in% c("Katsuwonus", "Thunnus")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Total.Length..mm.)) %>%          # remove NA lengths
  mutate(length_bin = floor(Total.Length..mm.)) %>%
  group_by(genus, Cruise, length_bin) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(genus, Cruise) %>%
  mutate(pct = count / sum(count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

#png("combined_length_freq.png", units = "in", width = 6, height = 4, res = 1200)
ggplot(freq_data, aes(x = length_bin + 0.5, y = pct, fill = genus)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge2(width = 1, preserve = "single"),
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cruise, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Katsuwonus" = "darkslategray2",
                                "Thunnus"    = "goldenrod1")) +
  labs(x = "Total Length (mm)", y = "Frequency (%)", fill = "Genus") +
  theme_minimal()
#dev.off()

table(individual_data$genus[!is.na(individual_data$Total.Length..mm.)])
```

###Reading in and making sure data are correct class
```{r}
station_data <- read.csv("Fish_plankton_tuna.csv")

str(station_data)

#making variables the correct type
station_data$Jar.. <- as.factor(station_data$Jar..)
station_data$Date <- as.Date(station_data$Date, format="%d-%b-%y")
station_data$Cruise <- as.factor(station_data$Cruise)
station_data$Year <- as.factor(station_data$Year)
station_data$Day.or.Night <- as.factor(station_data$Day.or.Night)
station_data$ADCP_velo <- as.numeric(station_data$ADCP_velo)
station_data$Water.Depth <- as.numeric(station_data$Water.Depth)
station_data$Tow.Depth..m. <- as.numeric(station_data$Tow.Depth..m.)
station_data$risen.or.set <- as.factor(station_data$risen.or.set)
station_data$Distance..km..to.nearest.island <- as.numeric(station_data$Distance..km..to.nearest.island)
station_data$What.is.the.nearest.island. <- as.factor(station_data$What.is.the.nearest.island.)
station_data$Tow.Type <- as.factor(station_data$Tow.Type)
station_data$Region <- as.factor(station_data$Region)
station_data$Current <- as.factor(station_data$Current)
station_data$Tow.Length..m. <- as.numeric(station_data$Tow.Length..m.)
station_data$Tow.Volume..m3. <- as.numeric(station_data$Tow.Volume..m3.)
station_data$Zpl.Density..ml.m3. <- as.numeric(station_data$Zpl.Density..ml.m3.)
station_data$Tuna.Density..ml.m3. <- as.numeric(station_data$Tuna.Density..ml.m3.)

#The rest are numeric so let's just do this:
station_data[34:148] <- lapply(station_data[34:148], as.numeric)

#let's look now
str(station_data)

#looks good, ecxept let's remove the one sample with a bunch of phytoplankton goop (S261-034-NT)
station_data <- station_data %>% filter(Jar.. != "S261-034-NT")

#Make densities in ind./1000m^3
station_data$Skipjack.Density.1000m3 <- station_data$Skipjack.Density * 1000
station_data$Thunnus.Density.1000m3 <- station_data$Thunnus.Density * 1000

#doing lunar angle instead of % illuminance (note: lunar.phase returns radians hence the transformation below)
station_data$lunar_phase_angle <- lunar.phase(station_data$Date, name = FALSE) * 180 / pi
station_data$day_since_newmoon <- station_data$lunar_phase_angle / 360 * 29.53

#should range 0-360
range(station_data$lunar_phase_angle, na.rm = TRUE)
range(station_data$day_since_fullmoon, na.rm = TRUE)

#Make deployments w/ > 0 larvae -> 1, none = 0
station_data <- station_data %>%
mutate(
  Skipjack_pa = as.integer(Skipjack > 0),
  Thunnus_pa = as.integer(Thunnus > 0))

#Make time 0-24
station_data$hour <- floor(station_data$Time / 100) + (station_data$Time %% 100) / 60
station_data$hour[station_data$hour == 24] <- 0

#See number of NAs (this is from Caroline):
na_table_tidyverse <- station_data %>%
  # Count the NAs for every column
  dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  # Convert the row of counts into a long-format table
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Column Name", values_to = "NA Count")

print(na_table_tidyverse)
```

###Mean Density of larval genera across cruises
```{r}
density_summary <- station_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Skipjack.Density) | !is.na(Thunnus.Density)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Skipjack.Density, Thunnus.Density),
    names_to = "genus",
    values_to = "density_m3") %>%
  mutate(genus = case_when(genus == "Skipjack.Density" ~ "Katsuwonus", genus == "Thunnus.Density"  ~ "Thunnus", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    genus = factor(genus, levels = c("Katsuwonus", "Thunnus")),
    density_per_1000m3 = density_m3 * 1000) %>%
  filter(!is.na(genus)) %>%
  group_by(Cruise, genus) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(density_per_1000m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_density = sd(density_per_1000m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_stations = n(),
    n_stations_present = sum(density_per_1000m3 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    freq_occurrence = (n_stations_present / n_stations) * 100,
    se_density = sd_density / sqrt(n_stations),
    min_density = min(density_per_1000m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_density = max(density_per_1000m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Cruise = factor(Cruise))

#png("tuna_density_by_cruise.png", units = "in", width = 6, height = 5, res = 1200)
ggplot(density_summary,aes(x = Cruise, y = mean_density, fill = genus)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.70, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_density - se_density, ymax = mean_density + se_density),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
                width = 0.45,
                linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Katsuwonus" = "darkslategray2", "Thunnus" = "goldenrod1")) +
  labs(
    x = "Cruise",
    y = "Mean density (larvae/1,000 m³)",
    fill = "Genus") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme_minimal()
#dev.off()

#Non-zero stations only
density_summary_nonzero <- station_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Skipjack.Density) | !is.na(Thunnus.Density)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Skipjack.Density, Thunnus.Density),
    names_to = "genus",
    values_to = "density_m3") %>%
  mutate(genus = case_when(genus == "Skipjack.Density" ~ "Katsuwonus", genus == "Thunnus.Density"  ~ "Thunnus", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    genus = factor(genus, levels = c("Katsuwonus", "Thunnus")),
    density_per_1000m3 = density_m3 * 1000) %>%
  filter(!is.na(genus), density_per_1000m3 > 0) %>%

    mean_density = mean(density_per_1000m3, na.rm = TRUE),

    se_density = sd_density / sqrt(n_stations),
```

###Testing for significant differences between cruises
```{r}
# Create the long-format data with ONLY positive densities (same filtering as your summary)
long_data_nonzero <- station_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Skipjack.Density) | !is.na(Thunnus.Density)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Skipjack.Density, Thunnus.Density),
    names_to = "genus",
    values_to = "density_m3") %>%
  mutate(
    genus = case_when(
      genus == "Skipjack.Density" ~ "Katsuwonus",
      genus == "Thunnus.Density" ~ "Thunnus",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    genus = factor(genus, levels = c("Katsuwonus", "Thunnus")),
    density_per_1000m3 = density_m3 * 1000,
    Cruise = factor(Cruise)          # make sure Cruise is a factor (your "years")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(genus), density_per_1000m3 > 0)

# ====================== NON-PARAMETRIC TESTS (recommended) ======================
# Larval densities are almost always right-skewed → Kruskal-Wallis is safest

# Katsuwonus
katsu_density_data_long <- long_data_nonzero %>% filter(genus == "Katsuwonus")

if (n_distinct(katsu_density_data_long$Cruise) > 1) {
  kw_katsu <- kruskal.test(density_per_1000m3 ~ Cruise, data = katsu_density_data_long)
  cat("\n=== Kruskal-Wallis Test: Katsuwonus across years ===\n")
  print(kw_katsu)
  
  # Post-hoc pairwise comparisons (only if overall test is significant)
  if (kw_katsu$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("\nPost-hoc pairwise Wilcoxon tests (Bonferroni-adjusted):\n")
    print(pairwise.wilcox.test(katsu_density_data_long$density_per_1000m3, 
                               katsu_density_data_long$Cruise, 
                               p.adjust.method = "bonferroni", 
                               exact = FALSE))
  }
} else {
  cat("Only one cruise for Katsuwonus – no test possible.\n")
}

# Thunnus
thun_density_data_long <- long_data_nonzero %>% filter(genus == "Thunnus")

if (n_distinct(thun_density_data_long$Cruise) > 1) {
  kw_thun <- kruskal.test(density_per_1000m3 ~ Cruise, data = thun_density_data_long)
  cat("\n=== Kruskal-Wallis Test: Thunnus across years ===\n")
  print(kw_thun)
  
  if (kw_thun$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("\nPost-hoc pairwise Wilcoxon tests (Bonferroni-adjusted):\n")
    print(pairwise.wilcox.test(thun_density_data_long$density_per_1000m3, 
                               thun_density_data_long$Cruise, 
                               p.adjust.method = "bonferroni", 
                               exact = FALSE))
  }
} else {
  cat("Only one cruise for Thunnus – no test possible.\n")
}
```

##Trying a GAM for presence/absence based off environmental parameters, and another for non-zero observations incorporating biological parameters

###Presence/Absence 
```{r}
#Skipjack - presence/absence (therefore using binomial family with log link)
gam_skj_pa_binom <- gam(Skipjack_pa ~
                        Thunnus_pa #incorporating Thunnus presence as a linear parametric predictor (not smooth)
                      + factor(Year)
                      + s(non.tuna.density, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(SSS, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(Zpl.Density..ml.m3., bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(day_since_newmoon, bs = "cc") 
                      + s(LatDec, LonDec, bs = "gp", k = 4) #significant
                      + s(Chla, bs = "ts")
                      + s(hour, bs = "cc")
                      + s(SST...C., bs = "ts")
                      + s(ADCP_velo, bs = "ts"),
                        select = TRUE,
                        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = station_data,
                        method = "REML")


glm_skj_pa_binom <- gam(Skipjack_pa ~
                        Thunnus_pa #incorporating Thunnus presence as a linear parametric predictor (not smooth)
                      + factor(Year)
                      + non.tuna.density #significant
                      + SSS #significant
                      + Zpl.Density..ml.m3. #significant
                      + day_since_newmoon
                      #+ LatDec, LonDec #significant
                      + Chla
                      + hour
                      + SST...C.
                      + ADCP_velo,
                        #select = TRUE,
                        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = station_data,
                        method = "REML")


#Checking performance
summary(gam_skj_pa_binom) 
plot(gam_skj_pa_binom)
gam.check(gam_skj_pa_binom)
AIC(gam_skj_pa_binom) 
gratia::draw(gam_skj_pa_binom)
anova(gam_skj_pa_binom)
concurvity(gam_skj_pa_binom)
vif(gam_skj_pa_binom)
acf(residuals(gam_skj_pa_binom))

summary(glm_skj_pa_binom) 
plot(glm_skj_pa_binom)
glm.check(glm_skj_pa_binom)
AIC(glm_skj_pa_binom) 
gratia::draw(glm_skj_pa_binom)
anova(glm_skj_pa_binom)
concurvity(glm_skj_pa_binom)
vif(glm_skj_pa_binom)
acf(residuals(glm_skj_pa_binom))

#Plotting final GAMs (one full and one with just selected significant terms)
#Full
#png("Katsu_PA_full.png", units = "in", width = 9, height = 9, res = 1200)
gratia::draw(gam_skj_pa_binom, parametric = TRUE, ncol = 3)
#dev.off()

#Just Significant
smooth_labels <- smooths(gam_skj_pa_binom)
print(smooth_labels)
sig_smooths_skj_pa <- c("s(SSS)", "s(non.tuna.density)", "s(Zpl.Density..ml.m3.)")#, "s(LatDec,LonDec)" ) #Put these in order of decreasing explanatory power

#png("Katsu_PA_presi.png", units = "in", width = 9, height = 9, res = 1200)
gratia::draw(gam_skj_pa_binom, select = sig_smooths_skj_pa, parametric = TRUE, ncol = 2)
#dev.off()

#-------------- 5-fold CV
set.seed(8)
k <- 5
n <- nrow(station_data)
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))
cv_probs <- numeric(n)
cv_lp <- numeric(n)

for (i in 1:k) {
  train_df <- station_data[folds != i, , drop = FALSE]
  test_df  <- station_data[folds == i, , drop = FALSE]
  gam_fit <- gam(Skipjack_pa ~
                        Thunnus_pa #incorporating Thunnus presence as a linear parametric predictor (not smooth)
                      + factor(Year)
                      + s(non.tuna.density, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(SSS, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(Zpl.Density..ml.m3., bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(day_since_newmoon, bs = "cc") 
                      + s(LatDec, LonDec, bs = "gp", k = 4) #significant
                      + s(Chla, bs = "ts")
                      + s(hour, bs = "cc")
                      + s(SST...C., bs = "ts")
                      + s(ADCP_velo, bs = "ts"),
                        select = TRUE,
                        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = train_df,
                        method = "REML")
  #Predict on held-out fold
  cv_probs[folds == i] <- predict(gam_fit,
                                  newdata = test_df,
                                  type = "response")
   cv_lp[folds == i] <- predict(gam_fit, 
                                newdata = test_df, 
                                type = "link")
}

observed <- station_data$Skipjack_pa

#Basic summary
mean(cv_probs, na.rm = TRUE) #0.2817565
mean(observed) #0.2767296

#AUC
roc_obj <- roc(observed, cv_probs, quiet = TRUE)
auc(roc_obj) #0.7619 

#Calibration plot shows whether the predicted probabilities are well-calibrated (i.e., when the model says 30% chance, do we actually see presence ~30% of the time?)
#Fit the calibration GAM (using your out-of-fold predictions)
calib_gam <- gam(station_data$Skipjack_pa ~ 
                   s(cv_probs, bs = "ts"),
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                 method = "REML")

summary(calib_gam)

#Predict smooth curve + uncertainty on a fine grid
newdata <- data.frame(cv_probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 477))
pred <- predict(calib_gam, newdata = newdata, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

#convert to probability scale
fit_prob <- plogis(pred$fit)
ci_lower <- plogis(pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
ci_upper <- plogis(pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)

#Plot with additional elements - probably easiest to do piecewise in base R?
#png("Katsu_PA_calibration.png", units = "in", width = 6, height = 4, res = 1200)
plot(0, 0, type = "n", 
     xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
     xlab = "Predicted Probability", 
     ylab = "Observed Probability",
     las = 1, bty = "l", cex.main = 1.1, cex.lab = 1.1)
abline(0, 1, col = "gray50", lty = 2, lwd = 1.6)
polygon(c(newdata$cv_probs, rev(newdata$cv_probs)),
        c(ci_lower, rev(ci_upper)),
        col = rgb(0.78, 0.78, 0.78, 0.35),
        border = NA)
lines(newdata$cv_probs, fit_prob, 
      col = "black", lwd = 2.6)
rug(cv_probs[station_data$Skipjack_pa == 0], 
    side = 1, col = "gray40", lwd = 0.8, ticksize = 0.025)
rug(cv_probs[station_data$Skipjack_pa == 1], 
    side = 3, col = "gray20", lwd = 0.8, ticksize = 0.025)
#dev.off()
```

###Presence/Absence of Thunnus
```{r}
gam_thun_pa_binom <- gam(Thunnus_pa ~
                        Skipjack_pa #incorporating Skipjack presence as a linear parametric predictor (not smooth)
                      + factor(Year)
                      + s(Zpl.Density..ml.m3., bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(non.tuna.density, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(SST...C., bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(LatDec, LonDec, bs = "gp", k = 4) #significant
                      + s(day_since_newmoon, bs = "cc")
                      + s(Chla, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(ADCP_velo, bs = "ts")
                      + s(hour, bs = "cc")
                      + s(SSS, bs = "ts"),
                        select = TRUE,
                        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = station_data,
                        method = "REML")

gam_thun_pa_binom <- gam(Thunnus_pa ~
                        Skipjack_pa #incorporating Skipjack presence as a linear parametric predictor (not smooth)
                      + factor(Year)
                      + s(SST...C., bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(Chla, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(non.tuna.density, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(Zpl.Density..ml.m3., bs = "ts") #significant
                      
                      
                      + s(LatDec, LonDec, bs = "gp", k = 4) #significant
                      + s(day_since_newmoon, bs = "cc")
                      
                      + s(ADCP_velo, bs = "ts")
                      + s(hour, bs = "cc")
                      + s(SSS, bs = "ts"),
                        select = TRUE,
                        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = station_data,
                        method = "REML")
#Checking performance
summary(gam_thun_pa_binom) 
plot(gam_thun_pa_binom)
gam.check(gam_thun_pa_binom)
AIC(gam_thun_pa_binom) 
gratia::draw(gam_thun_pa_binom)
anova(gam_thun_pa_binom)
concurvity(gam_thun_pa_binom)
vif(gam_thun_pa_binom)
acf(residuals(gam_thun_pa_binom))

#Plotting final GAMs (one full and one with just selected significant terms)

print(smooth_labels)

#png("Thunnus_PA_presi.png", units = "in", width = 9, height = 6, res = 1200)
gratia::draw(gam_thun_pa_binom, select = sig_smooths_thun_pa, parametric = TRUE)
#dev.off()

#-------------- 5-fold CV
set.seed(8)
k <- 5
n <- nrow(station_data)
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))
cv_probs <- numeric(n)
cv_lp <- numeric(n)

for (i in 1:k) {
  train_df <- station_data[folds != i, , drop = FALSE]
  test_df  <- station_data[folds == i, , drop = FALSE]
  gam_fit <- gam(Thunnus_pa ~
                        Skipjack_pa #incorporating Skipjack presence as a linear parametric predictor (not smooth)
                      + factor(Year)
                      + s(Zpl.Density..ml.m3., bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(non.tuna.density, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(SST...C., bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(LatDec, LonDec, bs = "gp", k = 4) #significant
                      + s(day_since_newmoon, bs = "cc")
                      + s(Chla, bs = "ts") #significant
                      + s(ADCP_velo, bs = "ts")
                      + s(hour, bs = "cc")
                      + s(SSS, bs = "ts"),
                        select = TRUE,
                        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        data = train_df,
                        method = "REML")
  cv_probs[folds == i] <- predict(gam_fit,
                                  newdata = test_df,
                                  type = "response")
   cv_lp[folds == i] <- predict(gam_fit, 
                                newdata = test_df, 
                                type = "link")
}

observed <- station_data$Thunnus_pa

#Basic summary
mean(cv_probs, na.rm = TRUE) #0.1939357
mean(observed) #0.1907757

#AUC
roc_obj <- roc(observed, cv_probs, quiet = TRUE)
auc(roc_obj) #0.8043 #seems better than skj model

#Calibration plot shows whether the predicted probabilities are well-calibrated (i.e., when the model says 30% chance, do we actually see presence ~30% of the time?)
#Fit the calibration GAM (using your out-of-fold predictions)
calib_gam <- gam(station_data$Thunnus_pa ~ 
                   s(cv_probs, bs = "ts"),
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                 method = "REML")

summary(calib_gam)

#Predict smooth curve + uncertainty on a fine grid
newdata <- data.frame(cv_probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 477))
pred <- predict(calib_gam, newdata = newdata, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

#convert to probability scale
fit_prob <- plogis(pred$fit)
ci_lower <- plogis(pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
ci_upper <- plogis(pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)

#Plot with additional elements - probably easiest to do piecewise in base R?
#png("Thunnus_PA_calibration.png", units = "in", width = 6, height = 4, res = 1200)
plot(0, 0, type = "n", 
     xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
     xlab = "Predicted Probability", 
     ylab = "Observed Probability",
     las = 1, bty = "l", cex.main = 1.1, cex.lab = 1.1)
abline(0, 1, col = "gray50", lty = 2, lwd = 1.6)
polygon(c(newdata$cv_probs, rev(newdata$cv_probs)),
        c(ci_lower, rev(ci_upper)),
        col = rgb(0.78, 0.78, 0.78, 0.35),
        border = NA)
lines(newdata$cv_probs, fit_prob, 
      col = "black", lwd = 2.6)
rug(cv_probs[station_data$Skipjack_pa == 0], 
    side = 1, col = "gray40", lwd = 0.8, ticksize = 0.025)
rug(cv_probs[station_data$Skipjack_pa == 1], 
    side = 3, col = "gray20", lwd = 0.8, ticksize = 0.025)
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
#-------------- 5-fold CV
set.seed(2025)
k <- 5
n <- nrow(station_data)
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))
cv_preds <- numeric(n)          #now holds predicted mean densities

for (i in 1:k) {
  cat("Fold", i, "of", k, "... ")
  train_df <- station_data[folds != i, , drop = FALSE]
  test_df  <- station_data[folds == i, , drop = FALSE]
  gam_fit <- gam(Skipjack.Density ~
                   factor(Year) +
                   s(Thunnus.Density, bs = "ts") +
                   s(Zpl.Density..ml.m3., bs = "ts") +
                   s(LatDec, LonDec, bs = "gp", k = 4) +
                   s(day_since_newmoon, bs = "cc") +
                   s(ADCP_velo, bs = "ts") +
                   s(SST...C., bs = "ts") +
                   s(non.tuna.density, bs = "ts") +
                   s(Chla, bs = "ts") +
                   s(SSS, bs = "ts") +
                   s(hour, bs = "cc"),
                 select = TRUE,
                 family = tw(link = "log"),
                 data = train_df,
                 method = "REML"
  )
  cv_preds[folds == i] <- predict(gam_fit,
                                  newdata = test_df,
                                  type = "response")
}

#Fit a GAM to describe predicted vs observed relationship
calib_gam <- gam(station_data$Skipjack.Density ~ s(cv_preds, bs = "ts"),
                 family = tw(link = "log"), 
                 method = "REML")

summary(calib_gam)

#Predict smooth + uncertainty
newdata <- data.frame(cv_preds = seq(0, 1, length.out = 477))
pred <- predict(calib_gam, newdata = newdata, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)

fit_mean <- pred$fit
ci_lower <- pmax(0, fit_mean - 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
ci_upper <- fit_mean + 1.96 * pred$se.fit

#png("Katsu_density_calibration_clipped.png", units = "in", width = 6, height = 4, res = 1200)
plot(0, 0, type = "n",
     xlim = c(0, 0.02), ylim = c(0, 0.03),
     xlab = "Predicted Mean Density", ylab = "Observed Mean Density",
     las = 1, bty = "l")
abline(0, 1, col = "gray50", lty = 2, lwd = 1.6)
polygon(c(newdata$cv_preds, rev(newdata$cv_preds)),
        c(ci_lower, rev(ci_upper)),
        col = rgb(0.78, 0.78, 0.78, 0.35), border = NA)
lines(newdata$cv_preds, fit_mean, col = "black", lwd = 2.6)
rug(cv_preds[station_data$Skipjack.Density == 0], side = 1, col = "gray40", lwd = 0.8)
rug(cv_preds[station_data$Skipjack.Density >  0], side = 3, col = "gray20", lwd = 0.8)
#dev.off()
```
